Cost: 250eb (Expensive) for 1

Ammo Types Available: Grenades

Cutting-edge ordinance that uses mono-drills to pierce the walls of bunkers and ‘illegally-owned’ housing.

Grenade Ammunition. When fired, this grenade will not detonate unless it directly impacts a piece of Cover. When this ammunition impacts a single layer of Thin Cover, it drills through to the other side and then detonates, dealing damage as a 6d6 explosive in a 6x6m/yds (3x3 squares) area out from the point of impact akin to a Shotgun Shell.

If it impacts Thick Cover, it drills in far enough for the Cover to instead be considered Thin Cover of the same material (e.g., Thick Concrete (25 HP) is Thin Concrete (10 HP)) and then detonates, only dealing damage to the impacted Cover. If this damage exceeds the Cover’s HP, it does not carry over to targets behind the destroyed Cover. Incompatible with Homing Adapter Kit and Sticky Adapter Kit.

Stack: 1

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Ammunition).
